dedupe_keys.name: era5 derived time series of european country aggregate electricity demand wind power generation and solar power generation

description: The University of Reading provides nationally aggregated wind generation, solar generation and electricity demand derived from ERA5 for 28 European countries. The resource landing page specifies 1979–2018, with three-hourly renewable generation and daily demand. Generating-asset locations represent the situation around 2017, not changing historically. This updated release corrects timestamp problems identified in an earlier version. An open ZIP archive, ERA5_energy_update.zip, is available under CC-BY-4.0 without a fee; its internal file encoding was not inspected. The ESSD S2S4E paper cites this DOI but describes hourly 1979–2019 data, which conflicts with the archive metadata. The record therefore preserves the repository coverage and flags the discrepancy for users to resolve against file documentation. The series could support interannual adequacy, demand-weather and renewable coincidence simulations. They complement data-era5-reanalysis with derived energy variables and provide a weather-based comparator to observed series in data-open-power-system-data. Fixed asset weights and national aggregation limit interpretation as historical grid operations.
